The constructor only initializes `userAddress` and `localPortAddress`; it does not perform a sensitive state-changing operation that can be abused by an unauthorized caller.

`withdrawERC20`, `withdrawERC721`, and `call` are all guarded by `requiresApprovedCaller`, which restricts execution to either the virtual account’s `userAddress` or a router explicitly approved by the trusted `localPortAddress` root port. The withdrawals and arbitrary call behavior are therefore explicitly authorized by the contract’s access-control logic and are intended virtual-account operations.

`onERC721Received` is `pure` and only returns a selector; it changes no state and performs no sensitive operation.
